sentence: The system shall be able to validate API keys in less than 2 seconds.
The system shall be able to backup 3000 records per second.
A report will display 50 data entries.
Query times will take no longer than 10 seconds to any data warehouse.
The system shall be able to email support staff and testers in less than 1 second.
If notification is specified the user shall confirm transfer from Enabled to Disabled status within 5 seconds.
The system shall have an availability of 99.90%.
The system shall be able to acquire subscription fees in less than 2 seconds.
Sending the alert to the default mobile device will take less than 1 second.
The software component is required to be functional at a maximum processing speed of 2000 transactions per second.
Loading the application settings will take less than 10 seconds.
Grouping results should take less than 0.1 seconds.
Data to enable investigation of system crashes need only be stored for at least 72 hours, and shall be very detailed.
The session token shall consist of a maximum of 12 alphanumeric characters.
The system shall be able to search for a specified file in less than 1 second.
